question: In which of the following cities is the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__

• The Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) is located in **Hyderabad**.
 
• INCOIS is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India.
